environment.description: ECS Fargate container running identical Node.js 18 image. Task definition specifies a custom JSON seccomp profile mounted via the linuxParameters.seccompProfile field (type: Localhost, localhostProfile referencing the ECS-managed profile at /var/lib/ecs/seccomp/restricted-node.json). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the following syscall groups: execve/execveat (prevents child_process.exec* from spawning), connect/socket/bind/sendto/recvfrom (filtered via SCMP_CMP argument matching for AF_INET/AF_INET6 on non-loopback destinations only — loopback socket operations on 127.0.0.0/8 are permitted via SCMP_ACT_ALLOW with argument inspection on sockaddr struct), and ptrace. Note: the profile does NOT block read/write/mmap/brk/futex or other syscalls needed for Node.js runtime operation. The ALB target group health check uses /api/status on loopback which remains functional.

seccomp_profile_summary.notes: Loopback exemption via SCMP_ACT_ALLOW on connect() where sockaddr_in.sin_addr matches 127.0.0.0/8 — implemented via BPF argument inspection at kernel level
